title: Exact affine and fourth-root quadratic phase contraction
summary: Useful for exact quantum-circuit simulation, modular weighted constraint problems, code enumerators, signed partition functions, and Boolean Fourier calculations.
content: Evaluate sum i^Q(x) under binary affine constraints when Q=c+sum a_j x_j+2 sum b_jk x_j x_k modulo 4, over an odd-characteristic field containing i. Affine substitution preserves the phase class; odd linear terms are eliminated using sum_x i^(a*x+2*x*L)=(1+i^a)i^(-a*L). Ordinary binary Gauss elimination finishes the calculation while retaining signs and phases. The pullback API also handles affine-supported stabilizer functions without introducing multiplicity.
whenToUse: Useful for exact quantum-circuit simulation, modular weighted constraint problems, code enumerators, signed partition functions, and Boolean Fourier calculations.
limitations: The kernel handles this quadratic phase class, not arbitrary nonlinear inputs. Straightforward affine substitution can take O(N^4) operations. Current Field helpers use small explicit field tables; the demonstrated implementation is not optimized for growing characteristic.
